claim_text: People planning pregnancy should follow current public-health and antenatal guidance for folic acid to reduce neural tube defect risk; methylfolate should not be represented as proven superior or automatically interchangeable for this outcome.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe, indication-specific recommendations and avoid unsupported supplementation.
ingredient_form_or_preparation: Relevant dietary and supplemental forms; verify exact product label and formulation.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Folate and pregnancy resources provide folate guidance and evidence context.
limitations: No individualized dose; follow current jurisdictional recommendations and clinician advice for high-risk situations.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
